# Pettifer

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged / advanced years  <sub>[v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** New Brunswick  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** farmer  <sub>[v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c17 P8](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0008), [v2 c18 P20](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0020)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v2 c1 P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

He is low in stature, heavy-set, and bald. He has a circular face and bulging azure eyes. He is habitually seen sitting on his veranda while smoking his pipe.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c6 P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## Personality

He is regarded in Brierley as an eccentric crank who is extremely candid and impetuous, always speaking his exact thoughts directly. Although he harbors a bias against matrimony and hates being pitied, he is friendly and pleasant at heart.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P25](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0025), [v2 c17 P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 c17 P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)_

## History

After relocating from Scottsford, New Brunswick, Mr. Pettifer bought Robert Bell's farm near Brierley and earned a reputation as an eccentric bachelor. He hired John Henry Carter to help around the house, though he kept unpredictable meal hours. Following an outburst over a runaway cow, he formed a close friendship with his neighbor Nell Abernethy and offered support to the local Improvement Society. His neighbors occasionally speculated about his personal life, including rumors of courting Isabella Pullen when he merely visited Gorham Pullen for checkers and business. Later, his wife Emily rejoined him, bringing renewed order, cleanliness, and domestic friction to his household while reinforcing his longstanding feud with Agatha Sowerby.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005), [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c1 P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 c3 P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 c3 P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 c4 P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 c17 P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 c24 P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 c25 P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 c30 P5](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0005)_
